acquisition method: The instrument was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode (DDA) using the FT mass analyzer
alkylation reagent: trypsin enzyme with 2 missed cleavages with carbamidomethylation of cysteine as fixed modifications
cleavage agent: To minimize missed cleavage sites, digestion with rLys-C was carried out prior to trypsin treatment.
collision energy: followed by 3 second data-dependent HCD-MS/MS scans for precursor peptides with 2–7 charged ions above a threshold ion count of 10,000 with normalized collision energy of 37%.
enrichment method: Proteins extracted from the immunoprecipitation-enriched stress granule preparation were treated identically.
fractionation method: Peptides were fractionated on an EASY-Spray PepMAP RPLC C18 column (2 mm, 100Å, 75 mm x 50 cm) with a 120 min, 5 – 35% (v/v) linear acetonitrile gradient
fragmentation method: followed by 3 second data-dependent HCD-MS/MS scans
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribid, Orbitrap Exploris 240

Tryptic peptide analysis was performed using an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) interfaced with an Ultimate 3000 Nano-HPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific). ... The LC/MS/MS analysis of tryptic peptides for each sample was performed sequentially with a blank run between each two sample runs using a Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Exploris 240 Mass Spectrometer
ionization type: Eluted peptides from the Easy-Spray column were ionized and sprayed into the mass spectrometer, using a Nano Easy-Spray Ion Source (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: For the quantitation, a label-free approach was used, where the area under the curve for the precursor ions was used to calculate the relative fold change between different peptide ions.
reduction reagent: resuspended in “buffer 5/125” [30 mM Hepes-KOH pH 7.5 (at 20 °C), 5 mM Mg(OAc)2, 125 mM KCl, 0.25 mM EDTA-KOH, 8.5% (w/v) D-Mannitol and 2 mM DTT]
reduction concentration: resuspended in “buffer 5/125” [30 mM Hepes-KOH pH 7.5 (at 20 °C), 5 mM Mg(OAc)2, 125 mM KCl, 0.25 mM EDTA-KOH, 8.5% (w/v) D-Mannitol and 2 mM DTT]
